# Data processing
Exact duplicate rows were removed, dates were converted to Date format, and negative pollutant concentrations were set to zero before daily averages were calculated. Multiple readings on the same date were averaged separately for each pollutant, excluding missing values and retaining NA when all readings were missing. The cleaned datasets were combined across years, with O3 concentrations reported in ppm.

```{r processing}
# o3_units: ozone output unit, "ppm" (default) or "ppb".
process_aq <- function(file_path, o3_units = "ppm") {
  aq <- read.csv(file_path, check.names = FALSE)
  
  names(aq) <- c(
    "date", "co", "units_co", "pm25",
    "units_pm25", "o3", "units_o3"
  )
  
  aq <- aq[!duplicated(aq), ]
  
  aq$date <- as.Date(aq$date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
  
  pollutants <- c("co", "pm25", "o3")
  
  for (p in pollutants) {
    negative <- !is.na(aq[[p]]) & aq[[p]] < 0
    aq[[p]][negative] <- 0
  }
  
  # calculate daily means separately for each pollutant
  aq <- aq |>
    dplyr::group_by(date) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(
        all_of(pollutants),
        ~ if (all(is.na(.x))) NA_real_ else mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  # check the requested ozone unit
  o3_units <- match.arg(o3_units, c("ppm", "ppb"))
  
  # Convert the daily ozone concentration when requested
  if (o3_units == "ppb") {
    aq$o3 <- aq$o3 * 1000
  }
  
  return(aq)
}

# process each year with ozone in ppm
aq_2018_clean <- process_aq("data/AQ_2018.csv")
aq_2019_clean <- process_aq("data/AQ_2019.csv")
aq_2020_clean <- process_aq("data/AQ_2020.csv")

# Combine the three years
aq_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  aq_2018_clean,
  aq_2019_clean,
  aq_2020_clean
)

```

# Monthly CO and ozone concentrations

```{r plot co-o3}
aq_all <- aq_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    month = as.integer(format(date, "%m"))
  )


# pool daily CO values by calendar month across years
co_monthly <- aq_all |>
  dplyr::group_by(month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_co = mean(co, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_co = sd(co, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_co = sum(!is.na(co)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# calculate standard errors and 95% confidence intervals
co_monthly <- co_monthly |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    se_co = sd_co / sqrt(n_co),
    lower_co = mean_co - 1.96 * se_co,
    upper_co = mean_co + 1.96 * se_co
  )


# pool daily ozone values by calendar month
o3_monthly <- aq_all |>
  dplyr::group_by(month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_o3 = mean(o3, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_o3 = sd(o3, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_o3 = sum(!is.na(o3)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    se_o3 = sd_o3 / sqrt(n_o3),
    lower_o3 = mean_o3 - 1.96 * se_o3,
    upper_o3 = mean_o3 + 1.96 * se_o3
  )

# prepare CO results for plotting
co_plot <- co_monthly |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    month,
    pollutant = "CO",
    mean = mean_co,
    lower = lower_co,
    upper = upper_co
  )

# prepare ozone results for plotting
o3_plot <- o3_monthly |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    month,
    pollutant = "O3",
    mean = mean_o3,
    lower = lower_o3,
    upper = upper_o3
  )

# Combine both pollutants
plot1_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(co_plot, o3_plot)



plot1 <- ggplot(
  plot1_data,
  aes(x = month, y = mean, color = pollutant)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ pollutant,
    ncol = 1,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:12,
    labels = month.abb
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly CO and ozone concentrations",
    subtitle = "Pooled daily means with 95% confidence intervals",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Concentration (ppm)",
    color = "Pollutant"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

plot1

```
\
CO and O3 are displayed in separate panels with independent y-axis scales so that seasonal patterns in both pollutants are readable despite their different concentration ranges. Both remain in ppm, but point heights should be compared within each panel rather than across panels.

# Monthly PM2.5 concentrations by year

```{r plot-pm2.5}
aq_all <- aq_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))
  )

# calculate monthly PM2.5 means within each year
pm25_monthly <- aq_all |>
  dplyr::group_by(year, month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_pm25 = mean(pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pm25 = sum(!is.na(pm25)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


plot2 <- ggplot(
  pm25_monthly,
  aes(
    x = month,
    y = mean_pm25,
    color = factor(year),
    group = year
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:12,
    labels = month.abb
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly PM2.5 concentrations by year",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Mean PM2.5 concentration (ug/m3 LC)",
    color = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

plot2

```
\
Points show the monthly mean PM2.5 concentrations, while connecting lines make it easier to compare changes across months within and between years.

# Interpretation
CO concentrations were generally higher in colder months, while O3 concentrations were higher in spring and early summer, with the highest pooled monthly mean in June. Monthly mean PM2.5 concentrations peaked in December in 2018 and February in 2019, while the highest daily PM2.5 concentration was observed in 2020. Comparisons should be interpreted cautiously because 2020 includes only January through April, and the pooled May–December estimates therefore represent only 2018 and 2019.
